'''1999 Decipher World Championship Bastian Winkelhaus DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds95.htm The Most Fearsome Deck At The Worlds], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002944/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds95.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Strategy ==

<blockquote>
well, I won't explain the manipulator part. Every character with ability less than 4 does something real special. The start is {{CardLink|There Is No Try|Dagobah-D-thereisnotry.gif}} and {{CardLink|Secret Plans|SE-D-secretplans.gif}}. Then on my first turn I search for {{CardLink|Shocking Revelation|CC-D-shockingrevelation.gif}}. The card itself isn't even totally useless but I use it mainly to look through my deck every turn to see where my key cards are. {{CardLink|Set For Stun|Premiere-D-setforstun.gif}} is an awesome card. You can surprise a lot of people with it. During worlds, [[Steve Brentson]] grimtaashed me lost on a hand of 11 cards, but I didn't loose a card. Then he drew up to exactly 12 cards because he had [[Yarna d'al' Gargan]] out. On my turn I scanning crewed his hand first, saw a hand of 3 speeders, 3 operatives, 1 ithorian and some stuff but no rebel, then set for stunned his only character on board, an ithorian, and masterful moved for a {{CardLink|Monnok|ANH-D-monnok.gif}}. At that point he realized what was going to happen but he couldn't get rid of a card. So I monnoked lost on his hand of now 13 cards to make him loose 8 cards. Instead of flipping next turn it took him three more turns to get the cards he needed and because of that I won. I got one time win against [[Clint Hays|Clint Hayes]] because he shut down my drains with [[A Gift]] + [[The Planet That It's Farthest From]]. If people play that in your area you might want to add a {{CardLink|Look Sir, Droids|Premiere-D-looksirdroids.gif}}.

This was the deck used by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] in the 1999 World Championship Finals.
</blockquote>
